{{Top|leg}}
'''Miisai''' was an an ancient art form whereby a small [[Tree/Legends|tree]] was kept inside a pot and the branches trimmed to control and shape the growth of the trees. In about [[18 BBY/Legends|18 BBY]], the [[Gray Paladin]] [[Laranth Tarak]] gave a [[Standard century/Legends|centuries]]-old miisai tree to the [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Jax Pavan]] as a gift, and Pavan learned how to perform miisai through application of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]], to influence the tree's development. After Tarak [[Death/Legends|died]] during an encounter with the [[Sith Lord/Legends|Sith Lord]] [[Anakin Skywalker/Legends|Darth Vader]], Pavan kept is miisai tree with him as a memento of Tarak.
